author: Aalekh Dhaliwal	& Anmol Kejriwal
title: Commentary on Indian Youth and Conflict Resolution
slug: While conflicts in society occur on various levels of the state, this article would focus on the conflict between the state and the youth of India, and the subsequent factions that arise within the youth owing to these clashes. This article will shed light on a more domestic and digital aspect of conflicts, and its resolution through the heightened awareness and involvement of India’s youth.
tags: Democracy, CAA, Social Media, Farmers, Protest, UAPA
